meta.name: baoyu-youtube-transcript
meta.description: Downloads YouTube video transcripts/subtitles and cover images by URL or video ID. Supports multiple languages, translation, chapters, and speaker identification. Caches raw data for fast re-formatting. Use when user asks to "get YouTube transcript", "download subtitles", "get captions", "YouTube字幕", "YouTube封面", "视频封面", "video thumbnail", "video cover image", or provides a YouTube URL and wants the transcript/subtitle text or cover image extracted.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 下载YouTube视频字幕和封面图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从YouTube视频获取字幕或封面图片
copy.tagline_en: Download YouTube video transcripts and cover images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to get subtitles or cover images from YouTube videos

howto.what: 给它一个 YouTube 链接或视频 ID，它会下载字幕（含自动生成）和封面图，输出带时间戳、章节的 Markdown 或 SRT 文件，并存到 youtube-transcript 目录、缓存原始数据以便重新排版。
howto.when: 当你提到“YouTube 字幕”“下载字幕”“YouTube 封面”等关键词，或给出 YouTube 链接并要求提取字幕文本或封面图时触发。

howto.what_en: Given a YouTube link or video ID, it downloads the transcript (manual or auto-generated) and cover image, then outputs Markdown with timestamps and chapters or an SRT file, saved under youtube-transcript and cached for re-formatting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to get a YouTube transcript, download subtitles or captions, get a video thumbnail/cover image, or give a YouTube URL and want the transcript text or cover extracted.

say_en.text: Download the transcript of this YouTube video as Markdown: <URL>
say_en.note: Chapters and speaker labels on by default

say_en.text: List the available subtitle languages for this video
say_en.note: Prints to stdout only, saves no file

say_en.text: Translate this video's transcript into Simplified Chinese
